_comment: "If Inspire Lightning was FUSED, deal 2 arcane damage to target hero." Authored as a TRIGGERED ability on ON_FUSE, which is not a trigger name -- and never should be. Fusion (CR 8.3.17) is an optional ADDITIONAL COST paid as the card is played, not an event: there is nothing to trigger on. The keyword is already implemented -- ability_keywords.fusion runs from the card's printed Fusion keyword on play and records the marker "fused_<slug>" in current_turn_effects precisely so a clause like this one can gate on it. So the mechanic was present all along and the card was reaching for a trigger instead of the gate.
